goals.name: Preserve the dynasty
goals.description: Keep the house alive and titled.

goals.name: Preserve the realm
goals.description: Keep the political order from coming apart.

goals.name: Preserve Church institutions
goals.description: Keep sees, houses, and the papacy functioning.

goals.name: Survive the mortality
goals.description: Keep enough people alive to till and pray.

goals.name: Defeat a local infernal threat
goals.description: End a manifestation or cell when it can no longer be denied.

goals.name: Become regional hegemon
goals.description: Turn collapse into a larger lordship.

goals.name: Restore devastated territory
goals.description: Bring a ruined place back to tillage and bells.

goals.name: Pursue sainthood
goals.description: Live so that the Church might one day name you.

goals.name: Join the corruption
goals.description: Make a bargain the chroniclers will not print.
